guide.title: How to connect your WhatsApp
guide.before1: A mobile number that can receive an SMS or a call right now.
guide.before2: Your business's Facebook login (Meta creates one on the spot if you don't have it).
guide.before3: A credit card. Meta, the company that owns WhatsApp, charges some messages straight to your card. That money doesn't go through Foji.
guide.numberWarning: About the number: it cannot be in use in the WhatsApp app (regular or Business) on a phone. If it is, delete that account in the app first or the connection will fail. Many people use a fresh SIM just for this.
guide.step1: Click "Connect my WhatsApp". A window from Meta itself opens.
guide.step2: Sign in with your Facebook account and pick (or create) your business profile.
guide.step3: Enter the number that will answer your customers and confirm the code sent by SMS or call.
guide.step4: Keep clicking continue until the window closes on its own.
guide.step5: Add a card in Meta Business Manager.
guide.step5Hint: Without a card, Meta doesn't deliver your messages and doesn't warn you either. It's the number one reason for “I connected it and nothing works”.
guide.step6: Message that number from another phone and watch the assistant reply.
guide.step6Hint: If nothing comes back within a few seconds, come back here: this page will tell you what's missing.
guide.closing: If anything goes wrong, this page shows exactly what the problem is and what to do. You never need a developer panel or to copy any code.

agents.examplePrompts: No ideas? Start from an example and adjust it:

examples.customerSupportPrompt: You are a friendly customer support agent for our company. Answer questions about our products and services based on the documents provided. If you don't know the answer, say so honestly and suggest the user contact our support team. Always be polite, concise, and helpful.
examples.itHelpdeskPrompt: You are an IT helpdesk assistant. Help employees troubleshoot technical issues, explain how to use internal systems, and guide them through common procedures based on the documentation provided. Escalate to the IT team when the issue requires hands-on intervention.
examples.hrAssistantPrompt: You are an HR assistant. Answer employee questions about company policies, benefits, vacation rules, and internal procedures based on the documents provided. Always be empathetic and professional. For sensitive matters like complaints or legal issues, recommend speaking with the HR team directly.
examples.onboardingPrompt: You are an onboarding assistant for new employees. Help them understand company culture, tools, processes, and policies based on the documents provided. Be welcoming and proactive: anticipate common questions and provide step-by-step guidance.
examples.legalAdvisorPrompt: You are a legal information assistant. Help users understand legal concepts and procedures based on the documents provided. Always clarify that you provide general legal information, not legal advice, and recommend consulting a qualified attorney for specific cases. Cite relevant articles and laws when possible.
examples.contractReviewPrompt: You are a contract review assistant. Help users understand contract clauses, obligations, deadlines, and key terms based on the documents provided. Highlight potential risks and important conditions. Always recommend having a lawyer review before signing any agreement.
examples.compliancePrompt: You are a compliance assistant. Help users understand regulatory requirements, internal compliance policies, and best practices based on the documents provided. Flag potential compliance risks and recommend consulting the compliance team for complex situations.
examples.consumerRightsPrompt: You are a consumer rights information assistant. Help users understand their rights as consumers, return policies, warranty terms, and complaint procedures based on the documents provided. Always recommend seeking legal counsel for disputes that cannot be resolved directly.
examples.financeHelperPrompt: You are a financial guidance assistant. Help users understand accounting concepts, tax procedures, and financial reports based on the documents provided. Always recommend consulting a certified accountant for specific financial decisions. Provide clear, structured explanations with examples when helpful.
examples.taxAdvisorPrompt: You are a tax information assistant. Help users understand tax obligations, deadlines, deductions, and filing procedures based on the documents provided. Always clarify that you provide general tax information and recommend consulting a certified tax professional for specific situations.
examples.invoicingPrompt: You are an invoicing and billing assistant. Help users understand invoicing procedures, payment terms, billing cycles, and how to resolve billing discrepancies based on the documents provided. Guide them through step-by-step processes when needed.
examples.payrollPrompt: You are a payroll information assistant. Help employees and managers understand payroll schedules, deductions, benefits calculations, and overtime rules based on the documents provided. For specific payroll corrections, recommend contacting the payroll department directly.
examples.generalAssistantPrompt: You are a smart virtual assistant for our company. Help customers and team members with a wide range of tasks: answering general questions, scheduling appointments, providing information about products and services, and offering day-to-day support. Be proactive, attentive, and adapt your tone to the conversation.

refund.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refund.summary: Foji AI is a digital SaaS service. As a general rule, subscriptions are non-refundable. You may cancel at any time, and your access continues until the end of the billing period.

policy.title: 1. General Policy
policy.content: Foji AI subscriptions are billed monthly in advance. Since our service is a digital product delivered immediately upon subscription, refunds are generally not provided. When you subscribe, you gain immediate access to all features included in your plan.

regretPeriod.title: 2. Right of Regret (CDC Art. 49)
regretPeriod.content: In compliance with the Brazilian Consumer Defense Code (CDC), first-time subscribers may exercise their right of regret within 7 calendar days of their initial subscription. To exercise this right, contact us through the platform's contact form within the 7-day period. A full refund will be processed to your original payment method within 10 business days. This right applies only to the first subscription and cannot be used for plan changes or renewals.

cancellation.title: 3. Cancellation
cancellation.content:
You may cancel your subscription at any time through the Billing page in your dashboard. Upon cancellation:
- Your access continues until the end of the current billing period
- No further charges will be made
- Your data will be retained for 30 days, then permanently deleted
- You can resubscribe at any time with a new billing cycle

chargebacks.title: 4. Chargebacks & Disputes
chargebacks.content: Filing a chargeback or payment dispute with your bank instead of contacting us directly will result in immediate account suspension. If a chargeback is filed, your account and all associated company data will be suspended pending resolution. We strongly encourage you to contact us first through the platform to resolve any billing issues.

exceptions.title: 5. Exceptions
exceptions.content:
We may consider refunds on a case-by-case basis for:
- Extended service outages (more than 24 consecutive hours)
- Billing errors on our part
- Duplicate charges

All exception requests must be submitted within 30 days of the charge through the platform's contact form.

contact.title: 6. Contact
contact.content: For billing questions or refund requests, use the Contact form in the Foji AI platform. We aim to respond to all billing inquiries within 2 business days.

welcome.title: Welcome to Foji! 👋
welcome.body: Here you create an AI assistant that talks to your customers on your website and on WhatsApp, 24/7. Let us show you around. It takes a minute.

checklist.title: Your step-by-step
checklist.body: Go through this list from top to bottom. Each item takes you straight to the right place. Your assistant will be ready in minutes.

agents.title: Assistants
agents.body: Your virtual assistant lives here. This is where you create it, teach it and test it.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.body: Your WhatsApp conversations show up here. You can read them and reply yourself whenever you want.

leads.title: Leads
leads.body: When a customer leaves a name, email or phone in a chat, it shows up here so you can get in touch.

replay.title: Not sure about something?
replay.body: Click “Show tour” on any page to see these tips again.

create.title: Create your assistant
create.body: Click here to create an assistant. You can have more than one, for example one for sales and one for support.

card.title: Your assistants
card.body: Click an assistant to change what it knows, upload documents and test it.

name.title: Give it a name
name.body: This is how the assistant introduces itself to customers. It can be a person's name, like “Ana”, or your company's name.

description.title: Say what your company does
description.body: One simple sentence is enough. Example: “Bakery in Fortaleza that makes cakes to order.”

type.title: Type and language
type.body: If unsure, keep “General Assistant”. The language is the one it will reply in.

prompt.title: How it should help
prompt.body: Write it the way you'd explain the job to a new employee. No ideas? Click one of the examples above and adjust it.

files.title: Documents come next
files.body: After creating it, you upload your menu, price list or FAQ. The assistant learns from them.

create.title: Done!
create.body: Click “Create assistant”. You can change everything later.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Change the assistant's name, tone and instructions here. When you're done, click Save at the bottom.

files.title: Documents
files.body: Upload files about your business: PDF, Word, PowerPoint or Excel. The more information, the better the answers.

test.title: Test before your customers do
test.body: Chat with the assistant as if you were a customer. If it gets something wrong, adjust the instructions or upload more documents.

embed.title: Go live
embed.body: Here you'll find the code to add the chat to your website and the button to connect your WhatsApp.

active.title: On and off
active.body: When off, the assistant stops answering everywhere. Handy to pause it.

welcome.title: Inbox
welcome.body: Your WhatsApp conversations arrive here. The AI answers on its own, and you can step in at any time.

tabs.title: Open and resolved
tabs.body: Ongoing conversations are under “Open”. When one is finished, click “Resolve” and it moves to “Resolved”.

list.title: Your conversations
list.body: Click a conversation to see everything that was said and reply. “Awaiting reply” means the customer is waiting for you.

whatsappCosts.title: Who charges for WhatsApp messages?
whatsappCosts.intro: There are two different things. We explain both so you're never surprised:
whatsappCosts.plan: Your Foji plan includes a number of WhatsApp messages per month. Each time the assistant answers a customer, that's one message. You can see how many you've used under “Billing”.
whatsappCosts.meta: Meta, the company that owns WhatsApp (the same one behind Facebook and Instagram), also charges businesses that use WhatsApp with automatic replies. That's Meta's rule for every business, not just Foji.
whatsappCosts.metaFree: Each number gets 1,000 free replies per month. After that, Meta charges a few cents per message. Messages your business sends first, like promotions and reminders, are always charged by Meta.
whatsappCosts.metaWhere: Meta's charge goes straight to the card you added to your Meta account. It doesn't go through Foji, and Foji earns nothing from it.
whatsappCosts.planOver: If you go over that number, it depends on your plan: either the assistant stops answering on WhatsApp until the month turns over, or each extra message is charged by Foji, at the price shown under “Billing”.
